title: docs(agents): port objectstack's model-free commit-trailer rule into the multi-agent section (objectui#9441)
body:
Fixes #9441

Clause-②: no — `AGENTS.md` is an agent-facing convention, not a published contract, accept set or public surface

## What

objectui's root `AGENTS.md` gains objectstack's model-free commit-trailer rule, as ruled on the card (ruling A, comment 5724938982, text only, no hook). One new bullet in `### 多 agent 协作纪律(并行修改本仓库,务必遵守)`, placed right after the bullet that begins 「每次 commit/push 前先确认当前分支」, which is that section's commit-hygiene neighbour.

- The two sentences of objectstack `AGENTS.md`'s paragraph beginning `**Commit message:**` are quoted verbatim, with exactly one clause removed: `, and the pre-push hook refuses a model identifier in that pair`. objectui has no such hook and the ruling adds none (option B was declined).
- A short warning says, per commandment #9, that nothing in this repository enforces the rule, that it works through the harness's own precedence sentence (the ruling's words are quoted), and that squash landing keeps `Co-authored-by` (pointing at objectui#9666).

objectui#9666 remains open: its ruling-C sentence (the cross-repo force-push line) is a separate card, serialised after this one by the claim.

## Premise checks (on `origin/main` 733fd5ac6, before editing)

- **H1, objectui carries none of the rule.** `git grep -n -iE 'Claude-Session|model-free|Co-authored-by' BASE -- AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md` exit 1, zero lines. Control: `git grep -c AGENTS BASE -- AGENTS.md` answers 5, exit 0.
- **H2, the source text.** objectstack `origin/main` df3ba164, the paragraph anchored by `**Commit message:**`. The port was compared mechanically: source paragraph whitespace-flattened, the one clause removed (it occurs exactly once), result byte-equal to the new quote line: `MATCH`.
- **H3, no hook in objectui.** No `.githooks/`, no `core.hooksPath`, no husky / lefthook / simple-git-hooks key in `package.json`, and no file under `.github`, `scripts` or `.claude` names `Co-authored-by` or `Claude-Session` (git grep exit 1). Control leg: objectstack's `.githooks/pre-push` pipes the pushed refs into `scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs`, whose header names "a model identifier in the trailer pair" as its second finding class.
- **H4, placement.** The multi-agent discipline section exists under the heading above; the bullet sits with the other commit/push bullets.
- **The squash claim.** The last 40 commits on `main` are all single-parent squash landings: 40 carry a `Co-authored-by` line, 0 carry `Claude-Session`, and none names a model. That count is today's reading and is deliberately NOT written into the file (commandment #9); the file points at objectui#9666 instead.

All five ran in one call, `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over `check-doc-links`, `check-installed-spec-pin-claims`, `check-required-check-set`, `check-shell-escape-residue` and `dollar-dialect-alias-census` (all under `scripts/__tests__/`): `Test Files 5 passed (5)`, `Tests 260 passed (260)`, verify-lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

- No changeset: the gate above says none is owed, and `AGENTS.md` ships in no package.

## Acceptance notes

- This branch's only commit ends with the model-free pair it describes (`Claude-Session` + `Co-authored-by: Claude`). The harness's attribution reminder in this session asked for a model-named co-author line; the commit followed the rule instead. That is the precedence the ruling relies on, used once.
- Observation, not filed: once this lands, its squash commit is a free reading for the question objectui#9666 left open (does the squash composer drop `Claude-Session`, or did those seats never write one?). The branch commit carries both lines. Carrier: the seat that lands this PR.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:在 objectui 根目录 `AGENTS.md` 的「多 agent 协作纪律」一节里加了一条:agent 的提交信息结尾统一用两行不带模型名的署名(会话链接 + 通用的 Claude 共同作者),PR、评论、changeset、文档和代码注释里也不写模型名。正文直接照抄 objectstack 仓已有的同一条规则,只删掉了「由 pre-push 钩子拦截」那半句,因为本仓没有、也不加这个钩子。

**为什么改**:objectstack 仓早已写明这条规则,objectui 的 `AGENTS.md` 却一个字没提,在本仓干活的 agent 就可能照着工具的默认提示写上模型名;而合并时这行署名会原样进入 `main` 的历史,事后不改写。您 9 月 18 日在本卡上裁定方案 A:只补文字,不加门禁。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:只改给 agent 读的说明文字,不影响任何代码、测试或发版。代价是本仓仍然没有机械拦截,效果取决于 agent 读到并照做;另外两个仓各存一份同文规则,以后改一边要记得同步另一边。回滚:revert 本 PR 唯一的那个 commit(5 行)即可。

**席位意见**:

**你要做的**:看一眼这 5 行 diff,同意就在本 PR 上点 Approve;之后翻 ready、入队由席位完成。
